contract_assessments.assessment: [contract:D03; lean:Aiyagari1994.uniform_upper_drift; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M04C/DriftBounds.lean; ledger:D03] The export constructs B>0 before quantifying over every price in Q, proves B dominates every upper income bound, establishes the required weak upper drift for all z>=B, and proves interval invariance for every supported labor realization. D02 and the proved buffer limit supply C; the positive-state marginal bound, derived consumption positivity and envelope supply a common L. Explicit K and B discharge the helper hypotheses. The savings split, integrable interior Euler equality, consumption Lipschitz bound and marginal antitonicity correctly establish drift; policy monotonicity establishes invariance. Utility, beta and the general compact iid labor law remain fixed across Q. No extra economic premise, zero-boundary marginal substitution, finite-time entry or later convergence claim enters. The ledger and nine audited exports agree with this scope.

dimension_assessments.summary: The export places one finite B>0 before all q in Q, dominates every e_max, proves drift for every z>=B, and proves each interval invariant for every labor realization.

The buffer limit and marginal bound give common C,L,K,B. Small savings yield drift algebraically; large savings give integrable Euler equality and a strict marginal comparison, which antitonicity converts to downward drift. Policy monotonicity proves invariance.

Resources and saving are continuous nonnegative shifted quantities, c+A=z, and the next state is R*A+w*l+k after the labor draw. withPrices preserves utility, beta and the income law; the conclusion bounds this actual household transition.

Rendered A93 printed 38–39/original PDF 39–40 and SE77 printed 161–162/original PDF 11–12. Proposition 4 and Theorems 3.8–3.9 support the marginal-ratio drift route; the uniform C,L,K,B construction is the approved new reconstruction.

BASIC, positive-consumption C1/positive marginal, C2/eventual RRA and explicit local bounds suffice. Helper ratio, positivity, envelope and Euler premises are discharged; no law-shape or stationary premise enters.

No drift or invariant-set premise is assumed. The ratio and buffer conditions supplied to the local helper are proved before use. Q may be empty but is not required to be; all nonempty admissible Q are covered.

The diff preserves accepted proofs and adds only D03 infrastructure, export wiring and audits. H11's envelope is an accepted transitive H12 dependency; normalized-price definitions add no continuity premise.

Resources remain NNReal and labor has an arbitrary ProbabilityMeasure on its compact interval. The proof integrates that law and bounds all labor realizations, without discretization, density or endpoint-mass assumptions.

Every value-marginal and envelope application proves positive resources and positive consumption. Large savings exclude zero next resources. Invariance, including a possible zero lower endpoint, uses policy order and feasibility, never rightMarginalValue m 0.

H12 supplies Integrable for ordinary next marginal utility in the positive-savings branch before integral_mono is used. The comparison constant is integrable under the probability law. D03 introduces no ENNReal.toReal conversion or assumption of stationary integrability.

The only new limiting argument is the scalar buffer limit as C tends to infinity. No weak, strong or moment convergence of distributions is asserted, and weak downward drift is explicitly not used to infer finite-time entry.
beta*R<1 follows from the assigned beta*R<=gammaStar<1 bound. Positive consumption is derived through H10 at proved positive states before applying the envelope; neither premise is silently added.

The new proofs contain no admitted steps, project axioms, native_decide or unsafe bypass. Controller prohibited-pattern and assert_no_sorry checks pass, with explicit audits for every new declaration.

All nine source exports match the signature and axiom inventories. Both audit files contain #check, assert_no_sorry and #print axioms for each; the target signature preserves the required quantifier order.

The Markdown ledger matches REVIEW_READY status, fixed primitives, uniform bounds, the savings split, invariance and boundary restrictions. Its exclusions of finite-time entry and later economics match the Lean export.

assetPolicy is the canonical unique maximizer for the constructed Bellman fixed point, and consumption is its budget residual. D03 bounds that policy's genuine income transition over the whole price set, rather than an assumed drift function or finite-state surrogate.

The common B is uniform over Q with utility, beta and law fixed. Drift covers all z>=B and invariance all supported draws. No finite-law restriction, pointwise-only cap or stronger probability interpretation replaces the contract.

The nine additions define income endpoints and prove buffer, consumption-growth and drift infrastructure plus D03. None implements stationary laws, tightness, convergence, asset supply, equilibrium or finite-time entry.
